card.name: Section numbers in label cross-references
card.fires_on: The digit inside a section cross-reference in parentheses, such as (2.2), (6.1) or (12.3), after "see Dosage and Administration" or similar. Also seen on a few other word endings in labels.

modes.label: Cross-reference digits
modes.description: A number inside a bracketed label section reference, often just before a comma or closing parenthesis.
modes.example: [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.2 ) and Adverse Reactions ( 6.<<1>> , 6.3 )]

modes.label: Other word endings
modes.description: Occasional word-final pieces in clinical text, such as a title or disease name.
modes.example: high-risk smoldering multiple myel<<oma>> patients (4-week cycle)

card.writes: Promotes tokens that close quotes or brackets and start a new line; this fits an ending of a reference or citation.
card.plain: It lights up on the section number inside a label's "see Section X.Y" pointers.
